transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me, I really appreciate it. Um, I hope I'm not taking up too much of your time with this. It's probably nothing major, honestly, just... well, I've been a little embarrassed about it. I work as a secretary, so I'm supposed to be the organized one, you know? 

But... I guess what finally made me ask for help is that I just keep forgetting these little things that I normally handle just fine. Like, um, I'll forget to return a phone call, or I'll forget to turn in a simple registration form. Or even just meaning to stop for an errand on the way home and completely blanking on it. It's not terrible or anything, but... I just wanted to make sure I'm doing the right thing by coming in to get it checked out. Does that make sense?
How long have you been experiencing these memory issues, and have you noticed any feelings of sadness, low mood, or loss of interest in activities during this time?

Oh, um... well, I guess it's been noticeably harder to keep on top of my organization and, you know, pay attention to everything for about 15 months now? I started taking this evening certificate program back then, just trying to better myself, and... well, I think maybe having that on top of work just made it a little trickier to manage it all. I really hope it doesn't sound like I'm just complaining about being busy! I usually handle things just fine, I promise. 

And as for feeling sad or, um, losing interest in things... no, I don't think so. I'm not depressed or anything like that. I still enjoy my normal activities. I just feel a little silly that I'm dropping the ball on these small tasks lately. Did I answer that okay for you?
Do you find yourself feeling overly worried or anxious about these memory lapses or other things in your life lately?

Oh, um... no, I don't think so. I mean, it's a little frustrating, sure, just because I really want to do a good job for my boss and be helpful, but... I wouldn't say I'm anxious or, you know, losing sleep over it or anything like that. I'm usually a pretty calm, upbeat person. 

I just... I mostly just want to fix this little hiccup so I can get back to being my normal, reliable self at the office. I really hope I'm not making too big a deal out of this by being here. Does that sound okay to you? Like, is it alright that I'm not super worried about it?
Have you ever experienced any strange thoughts or perceptions lately, like hearing voices or seeing things that others don't?

Oh, goodness, no. No, nothing like that at all. I haven't heard or seen anything unusual, I promise. I'm definitely still... well, completely grounded in reality, you know? 

I really hope my memory stuff didn't make it sound like I was, um, losing my grip on things or something. It's just the little everyday tasks that slip my mind sometimes. But no voices or anything strange like that. That's a good thing, right? I hope I'm giving you the right kind of answers.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy levels lately, like feeling more tired than usual or having trouble getting motivated to do things?

Oh, um... no, my energy is actually pretty good! I mean, I get a little tired at the end of the day, just like anyone else who works full time, but... I definitely don't have trouble getting motivated. 

I really like my job and I want to do well in my certificate program, so I'm always eager to tackle my to-do list. I promise I'm not just, you know, being lazy or slacking off or anything. I really do try my absolute best every day, it's just sometimes the little details slip away from me. 

Is that... is that the kind of information you need? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture and being helpful.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating or keeping your focus on tasks lately?

Well, um... I guess maybe a little bit? But it's nothing terrible, I promise. It's just... you know how it is in an office, or even in my classes. There's always something going on. 

Like, if I'm typing up an email and a phone rings down the hall, or if I hear two people chatting near the water cooler, my brain just kind of... hops over to that for a second. Or even if it's quiet, I might just have a random thought pop into my head about, like, what I need to pick up for dinner at home, and suddenly I've lost my spot on the spreadsheet I was working on. 

But I always try to get right back to it! I really do. It's just a tiny bit easy for me to get pulled away from what I'm doing. Is that normal? I mean, everybody gets distracted sometimes, right? I hope that doesn't make me sound like a bad employee or anything...
Do you also find it hard to stay focused when you're at home or in other settings, like during conversations or while reading something for fun?

Oh, um, no, not really at home. I mean, if it's something I enjoy, like reading a good book or watching a show, I don't have any trouble at all. I can just dive right into it. And with conversations... oh gosh, I promise I'm a very good listener! I always make sure to pay close attention when my friends or family are talking to me. I would absolutely hate for anyone to think I was ignoring them or being rude. 

So it's really mostly just the work and class stuff, you know? The paperwork and the office distractions. At home, everything is pretty much fine. I hope that makes sense? I'm trying to be as clear as possible so I don't give you the wrong idea... is it okay that it only really seems to happen when I'm working?
Do you ever find yourself forgetting things or getting distracted in non-work settings, like running errands or during chores at home?

Well, um... I guess maybe a little bit? But it's nothing major, I promise. I mean, everybody forgets things sometimes, right? 

It's just... well, honestly, it's kind of what made me finally decide to come in and ask for help. I've just been noticing that I'm forgetting little things that I usually handle without any problem. Like, I might forget to return a phone call to a friend, or I'll realize I forgot to turn in a registration form for something, or I'll mean to stop and pick something up on the way home from work and then I just... drive right past the store. 

I always feel so awful when it happens! I really don't want people to think I'm unreliable or that I don't care. I try so hard to keep everything organized, I really do. It's just these little slip-ups lately. Is that... does that sound like the kind of thing you're asking about? I hope I'm explaining it okay. I just want to make sure I'm giving you all the right information.
Looking back, did you have similar issues with forgetfulness or getting distracted when you were a child or teenager, like in school or while doing homework?

Oh, um... well, I guess... maybe a little? I mean, I really don't want to sound like I was a bad student or anything, because I always tried my best to be good! I never got in trouble for acting out or being mean. 

But, um... yeah, even back in elementary school, I guess I was kind of that kid who... well, I'd forget permission slips a lot. Or I'd do my homework and then somehow just lose it at the bottom of my backpack. My mom and my teachers were always so sweet about it, though. They just had to, um, remind me a lot. Like, step by step, to make sure I actually finished my projects. 

I always felt so bad making them do that! I really wanted to be organized, I just... I don't know, things just slipped my mind back then, too. I hope that doesn't make me sound like I was just lazy? I promise I was trying! Is it... is it helpful that I'm telling you this? I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions right.
